shared_elements: carved marks on a tall upright rectangular slab-shaped surface
linear incised/relief motifs arranged in vertical registers or bands
justification: The only real correspondence is that both are tall upright slab-like surfaces bearing carved linear marks organised along the vertical axis, which is generic. A depicts a bold relief composition — an anthropomorphic head-and-body form with a prominent ring/disc, curved bands and paired bosses — whereas B shows only thin angular incised sign-rows running along the margins of an otherwise blank field, with no figural or curvilinear imagery at all.
